places.notes: The climb up turns steep and sandy fast, but the 1881 lighthouse at the top looks out over Pittwater on one side and the Hawkesbury on the other, with a decent chance of spotting a humpback whale mid-migration in winter.

places.title: Jollys Lookout
places.notes: Brisbane's oldest formal lookout, built in the 1920s. 180-degree sweep takes in the D'Aguilar Range, the Glass House Mountains and Moreton Bay. Picnic tables and free barbecues laid on for whoever makes the trip up — no entry fee, no bookings, just the view.
